Transparent PNG maker

A transparent background lets your logo, product or graphic sit on any color or photo without a box around it. BG Studio does this by detecting the background color and making the matching pixels transparent. It is fastest on logos, icons, product photos and scans with a plain background.

How to make a background transparent

  1. Drop in your image or paste a screenshot.
  2. Click Remove background. If the wrong color is removed, click Pick color and tap the background.
  3. Raise Tolerance if a halo of background color remains; lower it if parts of your subject disappear.
  4. Keep the format on PNG or WebP, leave Transparent areas on “Keep transparent”, then click Convert & download.

Tips for clean edges

  • JPEG cannot store transparency, so pick PNG or WebP.
  • Edge softness of 1–3 gives smooth edges; Edge shrink trims a thin colored outline.
  • Keep “Only remove areas connected to the image edges” on to protect same-colored areas inside your subject.

Frequently asked questions

Which format keeps a transparent background?

PNG, WebP and AVIF keep transparency. JPEG does not: it fills transparent areas with a solid color.

Can I make a photo of a person transparent?

BG Studio removes backgrounds by color, not with AI, so it works best on plain, evenly lit backgrounds. A busy street or a cluttered room will not cut out cleanly.

Why are there leftover edges around my subject?

Increase Tolerance a little, add an Edge shrink of 1 or 2, then download again.

Is it free and private?

Yes. It is free to use and your image is processed on your own device, never uploaded.
